notes: The others have lives with each other. Off-screen, people fight (about chores, money, a joke that went too far) and make up a day or two later. Adults who get close can catch feelings, start seeing each other, sometimes in secret, and break up. You hear about it through gossip from whoever you spend time with, and in scenes it shows: two people being short with each other, a look between a secret couple. Romance is adults-only and never between family or mentor and student. See what you've heard in 🧰 Tools → 💬 Around.
